nodes.text:
Health Minister Dr. Christopher Tufton says a meeting will be held today amid concerns about a Human Metapneumovirus (HMPV) outbreak in China, which has caused severe infections and hospital overcrowding. He noted that Jamaica is monitoring the situation.
